title: No in-fiction way to reconcile with Lys after the Thornwold burning: 'ask her to come back' gives the identical rejection line every time, even after raising her regard back to +1 via unrelated positive dialogue - it's unclear whether she can ever rejoin or whether the door is simply closed for the rest of the run.
